title: ESPWA deep-learning model predicts estrogen receptor status from H&E slides in Haiti
summary: ESPWA was trained on 3448 H&E slides with matched ER status from breast cancer patients in Haiti. A TCGA-trained model dropped from an AUROC of 0.846 to 0.671 on the Haitian cohort, whereas ESPWA reached 0.790 on cross-validation. In an independent test set of 134 patients with slides prepared at two sites, AUROCs were 0.794 and 0.805. Preprint; prospective studies are only underway and performance is moderate.
ai_technology: Deep-learning model on H&E whole-slide images predicting ER status
